title: Sean Payton and the Broncos have a ‘crystal clear vision’ for WR Jaylen Waddle

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton and the Broncos have a ‘crystal clear vision’ for WR Jaylen Waddle
sources.description: One of the more exciting parts of yesterday’s Broncos OTA practice open to the media was that we got our first real look at wide receiver Jaylen Waddle as a member of the Denver Broncos. He was in uniform, making plays on the practice field, looking fast, earning praise from Sean Payton and his teammates, […]
